notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, builder, height, staffing, fire, fate or access source was found. Two WebSearch calls and the cached pages were checked. The Malbis Plantation water tower on SR-181 is a different structure and is named in the story only to prevent confusion. The brief's elevation 59 m is OpenStreetMap's ele tag (ground elevation), not a tower height. Needs a Baldwin County or Alabama Forestry Commission history source before the story can carry a build date.
